questions.prompt: An expert must never run more than 20 turns. pi has no step limit. Where does the cap go?
options: In a setting called maxTurns in pi's loop
In a finishTurn hook that returns { action: "end" } after 20 turns
In the tool schema of each tool
In the system prompt only, as a request to the model
questions.explanation: pi's loop has no maxTurns or maxSteps. A finishTurn hook can return { action: "end" }, so the expert counts turns there.

questions.prompt: A model reply is cut off by the output-token limit and contains a tool call. What does pi do with that call?
options: It runs the call with the arguments it has
It runs the call twice to be safe
It fails the call with an error, because the arguments may be incomplete
It ends the whole run at once
questions.explanation: A cut-off reply may hold half-written arguments. pi marks the call as failed, not run, and the model can try again.

questions.prompt: What does an abort do to a run?
options: It asks the model to write a shorter answer
It waits until the current turn ends and then stops
It removes the last message from the session file
It cancels the run from outside, and the signal reaches the model call and every tool
questions.explanation: An abort uses one AbortController per run. Its signal reaches the model call and each tool, so both can stop early.
